**📈 Fri 27 Nov: No clean setups today** (from 26 Nov close). 3 of 471 stocks passed. Valid 27 Nov, 30 Nov, 1 Dec.

**💡 Today's learning: "Save up to 50% means you'll save about 50%"**
- **🤔 What people believe:** If an ad says you can save up to 50%, most buyers will get close to that big number.
- **🔬 The fact:** "Up to" only promises the best case. An FTC study (May 2012) of a window ad saying "up to 47%" energy savings found 48.2% of viewers thought half or more of buyers would save about 47%. In Feb 2012 the FTC settled with five window sellers and now requires proof that all or almost all buyers can reach an "up to" figure.
- **🎯 How they fool you:** Sellers gain because the big number sticks in your head and the small words "up to" fade away. The headline percent may apply to one item, one size or one perfect case, so check what most people actually get.
- **Source:** https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/press-releases/2012/02/window-marketers-settle-ftc-charges-they-made-deceptive-energy
